V, 14</cite>) ought to have stated only one specified object (either ox or ass); ib. 63ᵃ (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 22:8">Ex. XXII, 8</cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="Q01776"><he>פְּרָטֵי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Exodus 22:8">Ib.</cite> <he>נכתוב … להני פ׳ גבי האיך</he> the text ought to have made these specifications (‘money or vessels’, <cite ref="Exodus 22:6">Ex. XXII, 6</cite>) in connection with this (verse 8).

<cite ref="Exodus 22:6">Ib.</cite> <he>כל הני פ׳ למה לי</he> what are all these specifications for (what do they exclude)? <cite ref="Chullin 66a:1-5">Ḥull. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>תנא … בכללי ופ׳ כי האי גוונא וכ׳</he> generalizations and specifications of such a nature the Tanna … makes use of for interpretation; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 64a:7">B. Kam. 64ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.
